messages:
Aisha: quick sync — followup on the pagination/retry surface for SDKs. want to converge before the cross-lang api freeze.
Tom: TL;DR: transport handles transport-level retries (TCP failures, short 5xx). SDK handles pagination-aware resume semantics and high-level backoff.
Ravi: concrete problems we've seen: duplicated items when an internal retry replays a previous page; missing items when token advanced but we retried with an earlier cursor. Those are nasty.
Becky: ergonomics: Python/TS users expect ``for item in client.list_items()`` to be robust and not require manual retry plumbing. Go users prefer explicit opts.
Aisha: proposal: default conservative behavior: per-page retries OFF by default. SDK will auto-detect a response header `stable-cursor: true` and enable safe per-page resume. Otherwise surface an error to app.
Tom: API sketches:
Python:
```
client.list_items(retry=RetryOpts(per_page=False, max_attempts=2))
for it in client.list_items_iterator():
    process(it)
```
TS:
```
const iter = client.listItems({ retry: { perPage: false, maxAttempts: 2 } })
for await (const x of iter) {}
```
Go:
```
it := client.ListItems(ctx, WithRetry(PerPage(false), MaxAttempts(2)))
for it.Next() { ... }
```
Ravi: also add a ResumeHandler hook: (lastToken, attempt) -> ResumeDecision { retryFromToken: bool, adjustPageSize: int | null } so clients can implement idempotency strategies.
Becky: tests: add a fake server test that flips stable-cursor on/off and simulates idempotency issues. CI should run replayer harness to assert deterministic iteration under retries.
deploy-bot: note: please include cross-lang compatibility tests for new RetryOpts fields.
Aisha: other concern: metrics — we need per-page retry counts, total retries, and whether resume used cached kv to avoid re-fetch. send to telemetry team.
Tom: doc note: explain the difference between transport retry and SDK resume in the user-facing retry guide. include examples and common gotchas.
Ravi: I'm happy to draft the resume_handler signature and pseudocode for server-side stable-cursor detection.
Aisha: ok actions: Ravi draft resume handler + example, Becky add tests and replayer harness, Tom update docs, Aisha file the follow-up RFC with samples. We'll aim to land before api freeze.
Becky: I'll open a PR for the test harness tomorrow.
Aisha: thanks all.
